brief.symptom: a clan-duty stay trip (a member leaves its party to unload and comes back) writes no trace at departure or at its ends (returned, clan_party_return_wait, craft_warehouse_party_unavailable, ticket expiry): a stranded waiter is invisible

cause.explanation: only a refused departure is counted (party:stay_trip:refused); the leave shows as a generic party_left raise and a return as a party joined record; the other ends and the 15-min ticket expiry (pending() filters it silently) record nothing

nonGoals: changing the stay-trip rule or the ticket lifetime
acceptance: a stay trip's departure and each end (returned, return wait, unavailable, expired) leave one decision-trace record; expiry counted
